brand.name: Stripe
brand.tagline: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue.
brand.elevatorPitch: Build and run a global business with programmable financial infrastructure. Accept payments, manage revenue, prevent fraud, and move money across borders—from your first transaction to your billionth.
brand.boilerplate: About Stripe: Stripe is a technology company that builds programmable financial infrastructure to make it easier and cheaper for businesses to start and scale. More than 5 million businesses build on Stripe, from solo founders to established enterprises. Its tools help businesses accept payments, manage revenue, prevent fraud, and move money across borders. Stripe has dual headquarters in San Francisco and Dublin.
brand.description: Stripe is a financial services platform that helps all types of businesses accept payments, build flexible billing models, and manage money movement.

voice.summary: Technically precise and commercially ambitious. Stripe connects programmable infrastructure to concrete business outcomes, supporting its confidence with scale, operational detail, and a broader belief in economic growth.

traits.name: Infrastructure-minded
traits.description: Explains products as adaptable systems businesses can build on, rather than isolated features.
traits.do: Name the underlying capability and explain how it connects to a customer's systems or workflows.
traits.dont: Replace technical specifics with vague promises of effortless transformation.

evidence.quote: Reliable, extensible infrastructure for every stack.
Stripe is programmable financial infrastructure that helps you build and run a global business.

traits.name: Outcome-led
traits.description: Leads with growth, saved resources, and practical business improvements.
traits.do: Start with an action and its business benefit, then explain the enabling product.
traits.dont: List features without showing what they help a business achieve.

evidence.quote: Safeguard your business without slowing growth
Move fast and free up resources with flexible billing models, including subscription management and one-time invoicing, tax, and automated reconciliation.

traits.name: Measured confidence
traits.description: Makes ambitious claims with operational evidence rather than exuberant language.
traits.do: Pair claims about scale or reliability with a number, time frame, or specific capability.
traits.dont: Use exclamation-heavy hype or unsupported superlatives.

evidence.quote: Handle thousands of transactions per second with consistent speed and reliability, even during peak traffic periods.

traits.name: First-principles ambition
traits.description: Frames financial technology as a way to improve the conditions for economic growth.
traits.do: Connect new capabilities to making businesses easier to start, scale, or serve globally.
traits.dont: Treat innovation as novelty without an economic or practical purpose.

evidence.quote: Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity.
We don’t assume the best way to do something is the way it’s always been done.

styleRules: Use sentence case for headings; favor short, benefit-led headings beginning with action verbs.
Aim for sentences around 18 words, allowing longer sentences when explaining technical capabilities or related benefits.
Address customers as “you” and “your”; use “we” and “our” to explain Stripe’s mission and what it builds.
Use precise financial and developer terminology when useful, and connect it to a clear business outcome.
Use em dashes for ranges and explanatory extensions; keep exclamation marks rare and questions mainly for FAQs.
Use numerals, percentages, and compact scale notation such as $1.9T; retain dates, units, and qualifiers with numerical claims.

audiences.name: Founders and growing businesses
audiences.need: Start accepting payments quickly and expand with tools that support new revenue models and global customers.

audiences.name: Enterprises
audiences.need: Reliable infrastructure, custom pricing, and support for complex integrations and large payments volumes.

audiences.name: Developers and technical teams
audiences.need: Programmable APIs, SDKs, documentation, and integration options that fit existing systems.

audiences.name: Platforms and marketplaces
audiences.need: Embed financial products, coordinate payments and payouts, and monetize transactions.

audiences.name: AI businesses and agent builders
audiences.need: Flexible billing, agentic checkout, and infrastructure that lets software transact.

pillars.headline: Infrastructure for business growth
pillars.message: Stripe helps businesses start, scale, and grow revenue with financial tools that work individually or together.

proof.quote: Grow your business with a comprehensive set of payments and financial tools⁠—⁠designed to work individually or together.
We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale.

pillars.headline: Global reach
pillars.message: Stripe helps businesses serve customers and move money across borders with global payments and financial capabilities.

proof.quote: Take payments anywhere—online, in person, and through agents. Access 125+ payment methods and 135+ currencies.
Process payments, store multiple currencies and stablecoins, and send and spend money globally.

pillars.headline: Reliable, adaptable foundations
pillars.message: Stripe gives businesses flexible integration paths and reliable infrastructure that can handle demanding transaction volumes.

proof.quote: Adapt Stripe to your business needs with flexible integration options.
Handle thousands of transactions per second with consistent speed and reliability, even during peak traffic periods.

pillars.headline: New models of commerce
pillars.message: Stripe enables businesses to monetize platforms, AI products, and emerging forms of financial services.

proof.quote: Monetize platform transactions—including payments, card interchange, and financing fees.
Stripe is the economic infrastructure for AI.

proofPoints.quote: More than 5 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth.
They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP.
From Black Friday through Cyber Monday 2025, Stripe processed more than $40B for businesses while maintaining a 99.9999% uptime.
Lyft worked with Stripe to build Express Pay, providing drivers the ability to decide when they want to get paid out—typically within a few hours of a ride.
